name: acquire_to_first_runs_ms
js: (async()=>{const t0=performance.now();[...document.querySelectorAll('button')].find(b=>b.textContent==='Acquire snapshot').click();await new Promise((r)=>{const i=setInterval(()=>{ if(document.querySelector('.ck-list button')){clearInterval(i);r()} },15); setTimeout(()=>{clearInterval(i);r()},30000)});return Math.round(performance.now()-t0)})()

name: select_sealed_run_to_timeline_ms
js: (async()=>{const t0=performance.now();document.querySelectorAll('.ck-list button')[0].click();await new Promise((r)=>{const i=setInterval(()=>{ if(document.querySelector('[aria-label="Execution timeline"] li')){clearInterval(i);r()} },15); setTimeout(()=>{clearInterval(i);r()},30000)});return Math.round(performance.now()-t0)})()

name: context_first_render_ms
js: (async()=>{const t0=performance.now();[...document.querySelectorAll('[role=tab]')].find(t=>t.textContent==='Context').click();await new Promise((r)=>{const i=setInterval(()=>{ if(/prompt text|no model call recorded/i.test(document.querySelector('[data-module="context"]')?.innerText||'')){clearInterval(i);r()} },15); setTimeout(()=>{clearInterval(i);r()},30000)});return Math.round(performance.now()-t0)})()

name: attempts_first_render_ms
js: (async()=>{const t0=performance.now();[...document.querySelectorAll('[role=tab]')].find(t=>t.textContent==='Attempts').click();await new Promise((r)=>{const i=setInterval(()=>{ if(!!document.querySelector('[aria-label="Attempts"]')||(document.querySelector('[data-module="attempts"]')?.innerText||'').includes('No attempt recorded')){clearInterval(i);r()} },15); setTimeout(()=>{clearInterval(i);r()},30000)});return Math.round(performance.now()-t0)})()
